_comment: Legend of the printed NSTU campus map (Карта кампуса), upper half only: the academic block north of
пр. К. Маркса (корпуса 1-8 and the library); dormitories and the southern block are left out on purpose.
Every object and how to find it in OSM. Stops and walkways are kept only around these buildings.
kind: academic (green badges), dorm (orange), facility (blue). number: the badge text.
osm: exact object (way/N or relation/N), wins over match. match: tag -> regex (all must match),
or a list of such dicts (any may match); tags of POI nodes inside a building count for that building.
count: how many objects to take (default 1). optional: no warning when nothing matches.
floors: file next to this one with the building's frame and floor plans (only корпус 4 has them).
viewRotation: the printed map is not north-up; ул. Новогодняя is on top. Derived from корпус 4
(its long side horizontal, above корпус 2), in degrees clockwise as used by the camera.
